title: Canonical map from open-object Ext cohomology to inverse-image cohomology
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $U\subseteq X$ open with inclusion $j_U$ [def-weil-open-immersion]. Let $A_U$ be the sheafification of the free abelian presheaf on $\operatorname{ULift}\operatorname{Hom}(-,U)$ [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. The sheafification unit maps the generator of the identity of $U$ to a section of $A_U(U)$. The inverse-image/localization comparison [lem-weil-pbc-etale-inverse-image-restriction] transports it to a section of $j_U^*A_U$ at the terminal object of $U_{et}$. The constant-sheaf adjunction classifies this section by $k_U:\mathbb Z_U\to j_U^*A_U$. For every abelian etale sheaf $F$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] and $q\in\mathbb N$, define $m_U:\operatorname{Ext}^q(A_U,F)\to H^q(U_{et},j_U^*F)$ by $m_U(x)=\operatorname{mk}_0(k_U)\circ j_U^*x$ [def-pc-ext]. All of these are the explicit constructions in the Lean module, without arbitrary choices of witnesses.
